# Species models

Each model combines a season window, gates (hard limits such as frost) and soft factors (a weighted geometric mean):

    index = 100 × season × Π gates × Π soft^(weight / Σ weights)

Evidence grades A-D are explained in [../science.md](../science.md). Lags mean the indicator is read that many days earlier, e.g. rain over the 21 days ending 5 days before.
